5:83.text: And when they hear what has been revealed to the Messenger, you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they have recognized of the truth. They say, "Our Lord, we have believed, so register us among the witnesses.

5:84.text: And why should we not believe in Allāh and what has come to us of the truth? And we aspire that our Lord will admit us

5:85.text: So Allāh rewarded them for what they said
beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of doers of good.

5:86.text: But those who disbelieved and denied Our signs - they are the companions of Hellfire.

5:87.text: O you who have believed, do not prohibit the good things which Allāh has made lawful to you and do not transgress. Indeed, Allāh does not like transgressors.

5:88.text: And eat of what Allāh has provided for you
lawful and good. And fear Allāh, in whom you are believers.

5:89.text: Allāh will not impose blame upon you for what is meaningless
in your oaths, but He will impose blame upon you for
what you intended of oaths. So its expiation
is the feeding of ten needy people from the average of that which you feed your
families or clothing them or the freeing of a slave. But whoever cannot find
- then a fast of three days
. That is the expiation for oaths when you have sworn. But guard your oaths.
Thus does Allāh make clear to you His verses
